Description: Rapid decarbonization with immediate policy action. Consistent with Paris Agreement 1.5°C target.
Key_Assumptions: Rapid coal phase-out, 5% annual renewables growth, aggressive carbon pricing, strong regulatory frameworks

Description: Current policies trajectory with gradual improvements. Achieves 2°C goal with delayed action.
Key_Assumptions: Coal phase-out by 2040, 3% annual renewables growth, moderate carbon price, mixed policy support

Description: Limited climate action beyond current pledges. Market forces drive some change but insufficient.
Key_Assumptions: Coal continues, 1.5% annual renewables growth, weak carbon pricing, fragmented policies

Description: Achieves 1.5°C but through delayed and accelerated action. Higher transition costs.
Key_Assumptions: Late coal phase-out (2025-2030) then rapid, 8% annual renewables growth 2031-2050, extreme carbon price

Description: Uneven transition: rapid in some sectors, slow in others. Creates transition risks.
Key_Assumptions: Coal phase-out 2035, sectoral variation in transition speed, moderate-high carbon price
